summons.desc: Summon only: creatures it releases (from its spawn script or component); [] for other kinds.

effect.desc: Status put on the player by the attack itself (spirit auras), else 'none'.

per_frames.desc: 'hit' = per hit, 'NF' = every N frames while touching/in the aura.

range_tiles.desc: Max distance to start the attack, in Terraria tiles, between the two creatures' centers (as Noita measures it).

lunge_speed.desc: Lunge only: launch speed, Terraria pixels/frame (AnimalAIComponent attack_dash_speed); 0 for other kinds.

sound.desc: Noita sound event played when the attack starts (from the creature's audio folder, played through the player's Noita FMOD); 'none' if Noita has none.
